run_workflow_transform_folder: run a copybara workflow to transform an origin folder to a destination folder
run_workflow_local_version: run a copybara workflow to produce a local version of source code for local development
run_workflow_vertex_version: run a copybara workflow to produce a vertex version of source code for cloud deployment
run_workflow_with_config_root: run a copybara workflow with a config root path to resolve absolute config labels
run_workflow_auto_destination: run a copybara workflow that auto-creates a temporary destination folder when none is specified
